verdict.rationale: Gumroad's own llms.txt documents first-party "OAuth + MCP" access that lets an agent list sales, draft, edit and publish products, and check payouts for a connected creator, so the product itself offers an official MCP integration. The evidence is a single line, though, so the depth of the connection flow is unproven. missing for 10: MCP server endpoint URL and connection/setup documentation, tool reference beyond a one-line capability list, OAuth scope details, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can actually connect.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: OAuth + MCP so an agent can list sales, draft and edit a product, add the files and links buyers receive and a cover image, publish it, and check payouts for a connected creator
